notes: The core installer is built in an isolated minimal environment and does not copy the developer Conda environment.
Local ASR, local embeddings, camera inference and voice-training runtimes are optional packs.
Only redistribute model files and third-party runtimes when their licenses allow redistribution.
The installer creates data, models, logs, backups and uninstall directories beside the selected install root.
The default Hu Tao assets must be reviewed for character, voice and model distribution rights before release.
